segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You crouch by the little cast-iron stove. The copper pipe doesn't go up through the roof to vent smoke—it runs straight DOWN through the wooden floor!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Careful, recruit, that's my emergency peppermint brew!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip grabs the kettle handle, but his oversized sleeve catches on the stove's iron damper rod.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip accidentally yanks the rod like a giant lever! The kettle rattles, a blast of compressed air shoots out from beneath the hearth, and a cloud of soot blows across the room—sweeping three inches of dust right off the floorboards around the central shaft!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip yells, waving his paws in the soot.
